title: Check the right endpoint
text: At $$x=\frac{1}{2}$$ the series becomes the harmonic series, the sum of $$\frac{1}{n}$$, which diverges.

title: Check the left endpoint
text: At $$x=\frac{-1}{2}$$ it becomes the alternating harmonic series, which converges. So the interval is $$[\frac{-1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$$.
